answer: The mechanism is a staked-duty auction on every action slot: to act, an identity must hold an unparked duty that costs a fixed slice of escrow and expires unused if no counterparty attests the result. A gale of new keys buys nothing, since each clone needs its own duty, its own attestation trail, and a trellis of distinct vouchers with sunk duties, so a farm pays linearly for every fake seat while earning only a one-time subsidy. An honest voyage of work recycles the stake; attackers never recuperate it. Ten thousand clones means ten thousand forfeited stakes.
